subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Expor trabalhos ou pesquisas escolares, em sala de aula, com apoio de recursos multissemióticos (imagens, diagrama, tabelas etc.), orientando-se por roteiro escrito, planejando o tempo de fala e adequando a linguagem à situação comunicativa.

components.description_pt: Integrar exibições visuais como gráficos ou imagens em apresentação para apoiar ideias-chave
components.description_en: Integrate visual displays such as graphics or images into a presentation to support key ideas
components.cc_component_description: Integrate visual displays such as graphics or images into a presentation to support key ideas

components.description_pt: Seguir esboço escrito para organizar e orientar apresentação em classe
components.description_en: Follow a written outline to organize and guide a class presentation
components.cc_component_description: Organize a presentation so listeners can follow a clear line of reasoning

components.description_pt: Ajustar registro de linguagem entre formal e informal conforme contexto e público
components.description_en: Adjust language register between formal and informal based on context and audience
components.cc_component_description: Adjust language register between formal and informal based on context and audience

components.description_pt: Gerenciar tempo de fala adequadamente durante apresentação em classe
components.description_en: Manage speaking time appropriately during a class presentation

cc_matches.description: Include multimedia components (e.g., graphics, images, music, sound) and visual displays in presentations to clarify information.

Differentiate between contexts that call for formal English (e.g., presenting ideas) and situations where informal discourse is appropriate (e.g., small-group discussion); use formal English when appropriate to task and situation.

Present information, findings, and supporting evidence such that listeners can follow the line of reasoning and the organization, development, and style are appropriate to task, purpose, and audience.
